description: The chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across various language families, with the vertical axis listing the categories and the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks. The vertical axis is labeled with language families, listed in the order: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indo, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The horizontal axis is labeled "# tasks" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by a bar of a distinct color, with the length corresponding to the number of tasks; the bars are sorted in descending order of length. The longest bar, representing IE-Slavic, is light blue and extends to approximately 79 on the horizontal axis, while the shortest bar, representing Basque, is dark purple and reaches around 5. The other bars have intermediate lengths, with IE-Romance (dark blue) at around 49, IE-Germanic (green) at around 46, Uralic (pink) at around 23, IE-Baltic (light pink) at around 19, IE-other (red) at around 17, IE-Indo (orange) at around 13, Semitic (dark orange) at around 10, and Turkic (light purple) at around 7.
